subject: CWE-787

subject: CWE-119
object: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer

subject: CWE-119
object: The product performs operations on a memory buffer, but it reads from or writes to a memory location outside the buffer's intended boundary. This may result in read or write operations on unexpected memory locations that could be linked to other variables, data structures, or internal program data.
